frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: villager UUID + hazard identity + safety generation
frozenDecisions.reason: Avoidance is a safety interrupt above ordinary tasks; it is not a village-owned profession task.

frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: beggar UUID + donor UUID + session generation
frozenDecisions.reason: Begging is an entity-pair social session, not a village-owned profession task. Donors from another village are forbidden so the session cannot cross village social ownership boundaries; donor selection must require the same village association as the beggar.

frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: villageId + LUMBERJACK + furnace identity + owner UUID + generation
frozenDecisions.reason: The finite furnace pool is shared by all lumberjacks in one village and profession; each furnace has an owner/generation reservation, and no lumberjack receives a private one-furnace slot.

frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: villageId + FARMER + work-cell identity + attached pumpkin position + owner UUID + task generation
frozenDecisions.reason: Naturally grown attached pumpkins use village discovery and the shared farmer work-cell dispatcher; the current independent per-farmer scanner is replaced, duplicate observations collapse to one item, and loose decorative pumpkins are ineligible.

frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: villageId + FARMER + eligible non-bank-employee villager UUID + work-cell lease generation
frozenDecisions.reason: Village Manager farmer-work assignment must not divert bank employees even when their vanilla profession is FARMER; bank employment releases an existing farmer lease and its exact claims, and removal permits later ordinary eligibility.

frozenDecisions.ownershipScope: vanilla MoveToTargetSink observation; no task owner and no route restoration
frozenDecisions.reason: The mixin may observe vanilla path attempts and stale-stop diagnostics until removal, but it cannot own, restore, or reissue task movement.
